trip.name: Tour du Mont Blanc
trip.startDateNote: This is the arrival day, the first entry in the itinerary — not the first day of walking. Arriving Thu Jul 1 2027 puts hiking day 1 on Fri Jul 2, the Courmayeur rest day on Mon Jul 5, and the last hiking day on Fri Jul 9.
trip.notes: 7 hiking days plus one rest day in Courmayeur. Shuttles cover the sections we are skipping.

money.budgetNote: Food, shuttles and hotels on-trail. Excludes Chamonix nights before and after, and flights.

sync.endpointNote: Cloudflare Worker that appends shared edits to the op log. Empty means sync is off, and pages fall back to queueing edits on the device. Set this once for the group; each person still enters the passphrase on their own device. See docs/sync-setup.md.
